title: Quiet static-schedule fallback marker
description: GTFS-RT (realtime) is unavailable and the board has quietly fallen back to the static schedule: rows still show normally, and a second faint pulsing dot is appended after the 'Actualizaciones cada minuto' caption as a low-key marker. EN VIVO stays green — this is a graceful degradation, not an error, so nothing should read as alarming.

changes.intent: Add a quiet, secondary marker indicating the board is running on the static schedule instead of realtime, without alarming the viewer.
changes.detail: When realtime data is unavailable and the app has fallen back to the static GTFS schedule, append a second `.screen__clock-refresh-dot` element after the 'Actualizaciones cada minuto' text (in addition to the existing leading dot). No text changes; `EN VIVO` badge remains green/unchanged.

changes.intent: Render the fallback marker dot with the same faint, quiet treatment as the existing refresh dot, offset in its pulse timing so it reads as a distinct signal on close inspection but not as an alert.

warning: Purely additive CSS/markup change (a second faint dot + delayed pulse) — no list reordering or item add/remove, so it does not trigger the app's no-TransitionGroup constraint.
